title: KAITO — Supportive Through Struggles〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe
se_run_men_004_1

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Heya!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Welcome, Len.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Is KAITO here?
I wanted to practice being a DJ some more...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, yeah. He's sitting towards the back.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But now might not be the best time...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What if the song Ken and his team made sounds so good because of the suspense it builds?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Suspense...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes! This strange tension...
It's like each note is clashing with each other and yet they still somehow manage to harmonize.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This must be the result of Ken, Nagi and Taiga having vastly different personalities. It's them in the form of music.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, uhh... What are they doing?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, right.
You still haven't heard, have you, Len?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The thing is, Toya is in charge of composing the songs for...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Really?!
And KAITO's helping him?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes.
He's the most creative one out of all of us. Plus, he knows quite a lot about music, so he's probably the best person for this job.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, I know what you mean!
It's so easy to understand what he's saying when he's teaching me how to be a good DJ.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Also, there's something different about him today...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I thought understanding what made Ken and his team's song so good would help me with mine...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But if it's the result of the three of them clashing with one another, then I might not be able to put that information to good use since I'm alone...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: No, but this is at least one thing we were been able to derive from their song!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That is why it's much too soon to be giving up!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They sang many other ones during RAD WEEKEND, so we may be able to find some more answers by analyzing and breaking them down.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right. Thank you for pointing that out...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'm feeling parched all of a sudden!
Huh? My coffee's all gone?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, we've been talking for quite a while now. I also lost track of the time.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Haha. Time really does fly!
MEIKO, can I get a refill? My usual blend, plea—

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Uh oh...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh? Len, when did you get here?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Is something wrong?
You look really anxious for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: N-No, I'm not!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hmm...?
You're acting awfully strange today, Len.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What? No, that's not true...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I don't think you need to hide it from them, Len...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: He thought it was cool how you were working so hard to help Toya.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Ack! MEIKO, why'd you...?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah, I see. That's what was going on.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: To be fair, you seemed much more helpful than you usually are, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. You finally understand what a cool person I can be, Len?! I couldn't be happier!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Th-That's not what I said!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Is that so?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Well, in any case...
Your super cool teacher will gladly take some time later to show you how to be a super cool DJ, Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Again, that's not what I said!!!
